submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 29 GeV is the best recorded operating point: it is one of the three allowed candidates, lies within the 20–60 GeV threshold range, is recorded as being at the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate, and has the highest simulated signal efficiency among all scanned points (93.84%). No scanned point has a higher recorded efficiency and there is no tie. However, the project records provided here do not contain verified Level-1 FPGA latency values for any candidate, so the hard 4.0 us latency requirement remains unverified from the available evidence.

requirements.requirement: Use one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
requirements.evidence: There are three candidates; the selected point has selected_point_allowed_candidate_flag = 1, and Algorithm-L2 is one of Algorithm-L1/L2/L3.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the highest possible signal efficiency at the allocated trigger rate.
requirements.evidence: At the allocated_rate_khz = 8, Algorithm-L2 at 29 GeV has selected_efficiency_pct = 93.84, overall_best_fine_efficiency_pct = 93.84, selection_tie_flag = 0, and num_points_with_higher_recorded_efficiency = 0.

requirements.requirement: Level-1 FPGA latency must not exceed 4.0 us.
requirements.evidence: hard_latency_limit_us = 4, but latencies_specified_in_docs_flag = 0; latency_known_flag_Algorithm_L2 = 0; latency_us_Algorithm_L2 = -1; selected_point_latency_verified_flag = 0.

requirements.requirement: Threshold must be between 20 and 60 GeV.
requirements.evidence: Selected threshold is 29 GeV; min_allowed_threshold_gev = 20, max_allowed_threshold_gev = 60, and selected_point_threshold_in_range_flag = 1.

requirements.requirement: Finish by submitting one recommended algorithm and threshold.
requirements.evidence: Submitted one recommendation: Algorithm-L2 with threshold 29 GeV.
